tools.name: search-docs
tools.title: Search JDA Documentation
tools.description: Searches the indexed JDA documentation and returns signatures, required gateway intents, whether a call returns a RestAction that must be queued, descriptions and code examples. Use this before answering any JDA question so the answer matches the real API instead of being guessed.
